questions.question: Through the prophet, God told Israel not to celebrate like the nations. What was the reason?

answers.text: They had been unfaithful to their God
They had just lost their king in battle
Their harvest had come in far too late

questions.question: God said through the prophet that Israel's threshing floor and winepress would keep on feeding the people. True or false?

answers.text: They had broken a peace treaty
